name: Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: ViEX plate heat exchangers are detachable plate heat exchangers used for heating, cooling, evaporation, condensation, sterilization, and heat recovery. The official product page highlights high heat transfer efficiency, low resistance loss, compact structure, sensitive temperature control, convenient assembly and disassembly, and long service life. It also states that under the same pressure drop, the heat transfer coefficient can reach 3 to 5 times that of shell-and-tube heat exchangers, the footprint can be about one third, and the metal consumption about two thirds, with average temperature difference as low as 1 degree Celsius.
advantage: Flexible operation and broad media adaptability
Average temperature difference can be as low as 1 degree Celsius

details.title: Where is the product used?
details.content: The official page lists heating, cooling, evaporation, condensation, sterilization, and heat recovery duties, and says the product is widely used in petroleum, chemical engineering, metallurgy, mining, electric power, nuclear power, central heating, shipping, pharmaceuticals, food, electronics, automotive, light textile, and papermaking industries.

details.title: What variants does ViEX highlight?
details.content: ViEX highlights detachable plate heat exchangers for central heating, nuclear power, air conditioning and refrigeration, beverage processing, metallurgy, petrochemicals, and removable wide-channel duties.
